description.value:
Requirements You're wielding a melee weapon registered as nanocyte gear, or you have a nanite unarmed attack.

You attack and infect your target, eroding them and hampering their movements from within. Attempt a melee Strike with the required weapon or unarmed attack. If you hit and deal damage, the target takes an additional @Damage[1d4[persistent,acid]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round. On a critical hit, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 2} instead.
